entities.summary: The Polish Theater in Vilnius is a Polish-language theater in Vilnius, Lithuania. It was founded in 1963 by actress and director Irena Rymowicz. It staged its first premiere comedy Ladies and Hussars by Aleksander Fredro in 1965. In 1990, the Polish Theater in Vilnius was awarded a collective Honorary Badge of Merit for Polish Culture from the Polish Ministry of Culture. Since 1992 the artistic director and director of the theater is Irena Litvinovič.
